about.label: About Us
about.heading: The Detailing Monk
paragraphs: Where devotion meets detailing. At our studio in Sector 11, Rohini, there is a fusion of American innovation and European perfection with Indian heritage — a harmony of technology, precision, and tradition.

We blend precision, care, and craft to protect and beautify your car. From premium foam washes to ceramic coatings and self-healing PPF, every service reflects our ethos of “Seva Through Detailing.” Your car is more than transport — it is a companion in your journey. That's why we treat every surface with reverence, restoring shine and safeguarding beauty with products from trusted global brands.

services.heading: Our Detailing Services
services.intro: At The Detailing Monk, every service is a crafted ritual blending precision, care, and devotion to transform your car.

categories.title: Paint Protection & PPF

categories.title: Compounding & Polishing

categories.title: Deep Interior Spa & Steam
categories.desc: Comprehensive dry-cleaning, germ-killing steam sanitization, and antibacterial odor removal to make the cabin spotless and fresh.
